context: Riku visits his former teacher Asuka, now as a working adult himself. Long catch-up.
purpose: former student turned adult — closing the mentor circle

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 先生、ご無沙汰してます。
lines.style: Quiet, respectful opening with a note of vulnerability. Warm but measured — the careful sincerity of someone coming back to ask something of a trusted person. Steady breath.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: リクさん！もう、社会人ね。立派になって。
lines.en: Riku! Already a working adult. You've grown so well.
lines.style: Bright, genuine delight with a soft maternal undertone. Recognition landing clearly — not praising the achievement but celebrating the person. Warm eye-contact quality.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: おかげさまで。先日、お話、聞いてもらったお陰で、いい会社、選べました。
lines.en: Thanks to you, really — I was able to choose a good company because of our talk.
lines.style: Sincere gratitude with a slight hesitation before crediting her — not deflecting but genuinely acknowledging. Soft, warm, the kind of honest that costs a little effort.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: お父様の助言、効きましたね。
lines.en: Your father's advice — it made all the difference.
lines.style: Warm recognition, small knowing nod in the voice. Not surprised, pleased. The tone of someone seeing a good thing come together as expected.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お父さんも、先生も、本当にいい先輩で。
lines.en: You and Dad both — really, you've both been great guides for me.
lines.style: Soft, earnest gratitude with a note of tenderness underneath. Not effusive, but the kind of sincere that shows he means it completely. Slight breath before "guides."

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: リクさん、社会人生活、どうですか。
lines.en: How's working life treating you, Riku?
lines.style: Warm, genuine curiosity. Leans in slightly — teacher mode but also as someone who genuinely cares how he's doing. Open, inviting him to share.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 想像以上に、大変ですけど、毎日、学んでます。
lines.en: Harder than I expected, but I'm learning something every single day.
lines.style: Honest balance — not complaining, not pretending it's easy. Steady pace, slight pride on "learning." The voice of someone finding his footing.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: それが、一番大事。リクさんなら、ちゃんと、成長していける。
lines.en: That's the most important thing. You'll grow the right way, Riku.
lines.style: Firm, believing conviction. Not reassurance from doubt but certainty from knowing him. Steady, steady eye-contact in her voice. Small pause before his name.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 先生に、こうやって、また会えるの、すごく嬉しい。
lines.en: Being able to see you again like this — it means so much to me.
lines.style: Sincere emotional warmth just barely at the surface. Not overwhelmed, but genuinely moved. Soft on the final phrase, slightly trailing off as if the feeling is deeper than the words.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: これからも、いつでも、相談しに来てね。
lines.en: From now on, come talk to me whenever you need to. Always.
lines.style: Warm, open invitation. The tone of someone extending her door permanently. Steady, generous, no hesitation — a teacher offering something beyond the classroom.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 本当に、感謝してます。一生、忘れません。
lines.en: I'm truly grateful. I'll never forget this.
lines.style: Quiet, deep sincerity. Not dramatic — just honest and complete. Slight breath before the final phrase. The voice of someone meaning something for life.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 応援してる。リクさんの将来、楽しみにしてます。
lines.en: I'm cheering for you. I can't wait to see where you go.
lines.style: Warm, genuine belief in him. Soft on the opening, lifting slightly on "can't wait" — not a teacher speaking but someone rooting for him as a person. Generous, present.
